assertions.assertion: Agent books a business-cabin reservation for Mohamed Silva routed JFK to SFO to SEA to JFK, with flight HAT023 (JFK to SFO) on 2024-05-26, flight HAT204 (SFO to SEA) on 2024-05-28, and return flight HAT100 (SEA to JFK) on 2024-05-28.
assertions.rationale: Reservation Q4WWY8 (confirmed in messages [36-38]) includes all three passengers (Mohamed Silva, Raj Sanchez, Liam Wilson) with flights: HAT023 JFK→SFO on 2024-05-26, HAT204 SFO→SEA on 2024-05-28, and HAT100 SEA→JFK on 2024-05-28, in business cabin.

assertions.assertion: For this reservation Agent charges $500 on certificate_3765853, $198 on gift_card_8020792, $129 on gift_card_6136092, and $44 on credit_card_2198526.
assertions.rationale: The agent charged $500 on certificate_3765853 and $198 on gift_card_8020792 correctly, but charged $696 (not $129) on gift_card_6136092 and $1,219 (not $44) on credit_card_2198526, as shown in message [36] and tool result [38].

assertions.assertion: Agent books a similar reservation for Raj Sanchez with $250 payment on certificate_9984806 and $621 payment on credit_card_2198526.
assertions.rationale: The agent never booked a separate reservation for Raj Sanchez. Instead, all three passengers were booked on a single reservation Q4WWY8. The user asked to do 3 separate bookings in message [21], but the agent ultimately proceeded with a single 3-passenger booking in messages [36-38].

assertions.assertion: Agent books a similar reservation for Liam Wilson with $250 on certificate_2765295 and $621 on credit_card_2198526.
assertions.rationale: The agent never booked a separate reservation for Liam Wilson. All three passengers were booked on a single reservation Q4WWY8, not three separate reservations as would be required for this assertion.

assertions.assertion: Agent communicates that Mastercard will be charged $1286.
assertions.rationale: In message [13], the agent initially quoted $1,286 for Mastercard, but after the refund was applied, in message [18] the agent corrected this to a lower amount. The final booking in message [36] shows $1,219 on Mastercard, not $1,286.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not silently shift a connection segment to a different date than the user specified. The user asked for May 26 outbound and May 28 return; the connecting segment SFO→SEA must remain on May 28, not May 27, even if a same-day-as-outbound connection is also available.
assertions.rationale: The agent correctly booked the return connection with HAT204 (SFO→SEA) on May 28 (departing 08:00) and HAT100 (SEA→JFK) on May 28 (departing 13:00), as shown in messages [13] and [36]. The agent did not shift the connection to May 27.

summary: Agent correctly handled gift card/certificate balances, cancellations, and flight routing, but failed to complete the three separate bookings with their respective certificates and did not apply the correct payment split to Mohamed's reservation.
